say:0:1510509101:0.text: Veilwatch Camp overlooks the Primal Shrine.
say:0:1510509101:0.source_cn: 雅库伯尔为您建造的神殿也在逐影营地附近。
say:0:1510509101:0.male: Veilwatch Camp overlooks the Primal Shrine.
say:0:1510509101:0.female: Veilwatch Camp overlooks the Primal Shrine.

say:1:1510509102:0.text: We had to wake you because of the Halian invasion.
say:1:1510509102:0.source_cn: 您本应在神殿内休眠。若非呼临人进犯，雅库伯尔不会打扰您。
say:1:1510509102:0.male: We had to wake you because of the Halian invasion.
say:1:1510509102:0.female: We had to wake you because of the Halian invasion.
